I picked A from physical reasoning, not from a causal test on the data. The correlation between Residual_heat_flux and Residual_longwave is only about 0.21. That shows the two variables are associated but gives no direction.

The surface heat flux changes the lower-atmosphere temperature and moisture, and that changes the longwave radiation at the surface. The reverse path, longwave driving the heat flux, seems less likely. I did not run a direction-of-causation check, such as an additive-noise-model test, so this is a judgement call.

ANSWER: A
